correctness.rationale: The support graph exactly represents the stipulated single stochastic rounding: an exact binary16 output has probability 1, otherwise both bracketing states have strictly positive probability. Independently enumerating scaled integers in units 2^-24 and finding the bracket by the local binary16 spacing reproduces all 15,361 states and 30,623 arcs and the transition SHA-256 94b900c38f4dfb6e88c690e7cdead1540bce5d3836c0daa46b0534d0b89c2917. The forward/backward reachability intersection at code 0x3a01 is one 1,746-state SCC; deleting it and ignoring singleton self-loops leaves an acyclic graph by a topological elimination, giving 13,616 SCCs total. This large SCC has an exit, and the only closed singleton classes are 0 and 3/4. Reverse walks give reachability sizes 15,359 and 46 with intersection 44, and only 1/4 and 3/4 reach 3/4 alone. The maximum shortest distance is 23 at seven states. An independent exact rational Tarjan computation agreed. To infer finite-time absorption, every start has a path of at most 23 arcs to a sink, so the smallest positive transition probability gives a uniform positive chance of absorption in each 23-step block, conditional on the start of the block. Every reachable absorber has positive hitting probability, giving the claimed partition. Replay: python3 /workspace/reproductions/binary16_logistic.py. The supplied verify.py was inspected, not run.
residual_risks: Exact for the nonuniform binary16 mesh including subnormals, signed zeros merged and 1 included. Intermediate rounding, other parameters/formats or finite pseudorandom implementations need not have this graph.
A positive path of length at most 23 is not a bound on the random hitting time.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural-format support census motivated by the distinction between numerical recovery of finite-time chaotic behavior and the true infinite-horizon law. The two sinks and the exact mixed-outcome partition quantify that failure of indefinite nonperiodicity, even without deterministic rounding or a finite random-number period. They also distinguish near-universal certain fixation at zero from the blanket claim that every start fixes at zero.
residual_risks: No informative practical hitting-time scale or individual mixed-state probabilities were computed; no implication for the exact experimental software or other precision levels is claimed.
